name: SendEmail
description: Sends an email using Microsoft 365 Outlook via Microsoft Graph API. Supports recipients, CC, BCC, content type, importance, sensitivity, and optional saving to Sent Items.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: The Microsoft 365 credential containing OAuth details required to authenticate and send the email.

fields.name: To
fields.label: To
fields.description: Primary recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: From
fields.label: From (Send As)
fields.description: The sender's email address. The credential must have 'Send As' permissions for this address.

fields.name: Subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The subject line of the email message.

fields.name: CC
fields.label: CC
fields.description: Carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: BCC
fields.label: BCC
fields.description: Blind carbon copy recipient email address(es). Separate multiple addresses with semicolons (;).

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: The format of the email body (Text or Html).

fields.name: Content
fields.label: Content
fields.description: The body of the email message. Can contain plain text or HTML depending on the content type.

fields.name: Importance
fields.label: Importance
fields.description: The priority level of the email.

fields.name: Sensitivity
fields.label: Sensitivity
fields.description: Specifies the sensitivity of the email.

fields.name: SaveToSentItems
fields.label: Save to Sent Items
fields.description: Indicates whether the sent email should be saved in the Sent Items folder.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the status and details of the sent email.
